alt: 진입 대기 큐와 공유 데이터·연산·초기화 코드가 있는 모니터
prompt: Create ONE original raster PNG technical educational diagram for a Korean IT blog. White opaque background, navy readable sans-serif text, flat blue/teal boxes, generous whitespace. Use only the exact subject and components below. No logos, watermark, decorative illustrations, unrelated graphs, extra numeric values or invented facts. Redesign composition rather than copy source. Every connection must be accurate and labels fully readable.  Title Monitor structure. Large boundary Monitor with three internal stacked regions Shared data / Operations: P1, P2, …, Pn / Initialization code. Above entry queue three waiting thread cards outside boundary, arrow toward monitor entrance. Inside operations region highlight exactly ONE active thread. Caption At most one thread executes inside the monitor at a time. No external thread executes shared data simultaneously. Generic monitor, no Java-specific signal scheduling.
